_comment: Curated dataset of notable US data centers and AI/cloud campuses. Figures are best-effort estimates compiled from public reporting (company announcements, utility interconnection filings, permit dockets, press) for VISUALIZATION/DEMO purposes and should NOT be treated as authoritative. Field guide: operator = who runs the facility; owner = parent / asset owner; legal_entity = SPV or filing entity where publicly identifiable; tenants = principal occupier(s) ('self' = owner-occupied hyperscale); status = constructed | under_construction | planned; permit_status = approved | permitted | pending | not_required; capacity_mw = planned/critical IT power at full build; consumed_mw = estimated current load (0 if not operational); value_usd = estimated capital investment; utility/substation/voltage_kv/interconnection_mw/interconnection_status describe the grid connection; lease_type = owner-occupied | wholesale | colocation; rent_per_kw_month = indicative wholesale/colo lease rate in USD where the site leases space (null for owner-occupied). 'available' headroom is computed as max(capacity_mw - consumed_mw, 0) for constructed sites.
_disclaimer: Illustrative estimates, not legal, financial, or engineering advice.
